comments.author: Rockytop
comments.body:
Easiest way to get this is to sit outside Santo Domingo docks and wait for John Hawkins. Use a couple of the Letter of Appreciation from Seafarers and "Receive Endorsement" when he comes out, talk w/ him and you've got it!

That's my easiest way at least. I'm lazy.

comments.author: Romanovska
comments.body:
Can get from Receive Endorsement with Volg Ali at Tyrrhenian Sea
His fleet sail around Algiers and Tunis with Ottoman flag and make of 1 galleass and 3 heavy galleys
Keep an eye for the spanish fleet Andrea Giege in same area (he sails around Sassari - Cagliari or Tunis) as he gives Sword Fighter card as well

comments.author: Renkosa
comments.body: Pete Hyne Dutch NPC fleet of 5 also gives this sailing into Santo Domingo

wiki:
Note: Job Card can also be obtained by using x1 Letter of Appreciation from Seafarers for Receive Endorsement and then receiving it from the following flagged NPCs.

1. Saliph Leith (Ottoman; Black Sea)
2. Volg Ali (Ottoman; Western Mediterranean - Tyrrhenian Sea)
3. Pete Hyne (Netherlands; Caribbean - Antilles, Open Sea)
4. John Hawkins (England; Caribbean - San Juan, Open Sea)
5. Hawkins (England; Caribbean - West Caribbean Sea)
6. Ralph Stout (England; Southeast Asia - Andaman Sea)
